title: Statement and Earnings Visibility Terms of the Keyturn Host Payout Account
content:
The earnings statement of a Keyturn Host Payout Account closes on a day of the month set by the schedule, reaches the host a stated number of business days later, and shows earnings that are not yet payable a stated distance ahead.

## Terms by schedule

| Payout schedule | Statement close day | Delivery after close | Earnings visible ahead | Several vehicles settle as one transfer | Statement broken down by vehicle | Trips in a statement month earning a bonus |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard | 28 | 5 business days | 30 days | Yes | No | 20 |
| Weekly Batch | 28 | 5 business days | 45 days | Yes | No | 20 |
| Express | 28 | 4 business days | 60 days | Yes | Yes | 15 |
| Instant | 28 | 3 business days | 60 days | Yes | Yes | 15 |
| Fleet Settlement | 25 | 7 business days | 90 days | Yes | Yes | 60 |
| Reserve-Backed Settlement | 25 | 7 business days | 120 days | Yes | Yes | 100 |

## Terms in words

The statement closes on day 28 of the month on the first four schedules and on day 25 on the Keyturn Fleet Settlement Schedule and the Keyturn Reserve-Backed Settlement Schedule. It reaches the host within the delivery period in business days after the close, which runs from 3 business days on the Keyturn Instant Payout Schedule to 7 business days on the two settlement schedules. Earnings that are not yet payable are visible to the host for the visibility period in calendar days ahead, from 30 days on the Keyturn Standard Payout Schedule to 120 days on the Keyturn Reserve-Backed Settlement Schedule.

Earnings from several vehicles settle as one transfer on every schedule. Whether the statement is broken down by vehicle is not uniform: it is not on the Keyturn Standard Payout Schedule or the Keyturn Weekly Batch Payout Schedule, and it is on the other four. The last column gives the settled trips in a statement month that earn a promotional bonus, which is 20 on the first two schedules, 15 on the Keyturn Express Payout Schedule and the Keyturn Instant Payout Schedule, 60 on the Keyturn Fleet Settlement Schedule and 100 on the Keyturn Reserve-Backed Settlement Schedule.
